title: Thacker Pass Department of Energy Loan Financial Close — Phase 65 Nevada lithium project delivery review
summary: Phase 65 reviews this primary record as part of the Nevada lithium project delivery reporting pack. DOE records financial close of a $2.26 billion loan for Thacker Pass processing facilities and reports projected first-phase capacity and employment estimates, while delivery and operating milestones remain open.
key_findings: The project crossed financial close for a named federal loan rather than remaining at conditional-commitment stage.
DOE reports projected first-phase output of 40,000 tonnes of battery-grade lithium carbonate per year.
Construction completion, loan draws, commissioning, qualification, sales, sustained output, and repayment are not established by the close announcement.
why_it_matters: Which records separate land and environmental authorization, financing, construction, commissioning, compliance, qualification, customer acceptance, and repeat output? This record supplies one bounded part of that evidence chain; it is not a substitute for the pack's downstream records. Financial close is a stronger conversion signal than an announced program or conditional commitment, but it still sits upstream of a functioning production system.
ftfn_relevance: Adds a material finance milestone to the Nevada shelf.
Connects federal credit to a named processing build.
Creates downstream checks for disbursement, construction, qualification, sales, and repayment.
evidence_limits: Inclusion in a Phase 65 reporting pack does not advance a Phase 64 matrix cell or establish an operating outcome.
Projected capacity is not actual or qualified production.
Financial close does not prove full disbursement, on-time construction, or commercial performance.
Employment figures are project estimates rather than audited operating results.
